ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15:0.85 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous regions are localized at the distal tips. The left distal tip features a consolidated triangular white patch (~15% of lobe area). The right distal tip features a mottled, lower-density white patch (~10% of lobe area). The remainder of the fluke is dominated by a contiguous low-intensity (black) pixel field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 85 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to approximately 10% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (5-15 pixels) serrations are present along the lateral edges of both lobes. A significant, smooth-edged U-shaped macroscopic indentation (approx. 50 pixels wide) is present on the right lobe margin adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending from the central peduncle insertion to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of small, circular high-contrast white spots (diameter < 5 pixels) are concentrated around the median notch and the lower central margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical linear mark (approx. 80 pixels long) is visible on the left lobe. A shorter diagonal linear disruption is visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent U-shaped tissue deficit/indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe. A minor notch/indentation is visible on the lower-left proximal margin near the peduncle connection.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, high-contrast hook-shaped marking is located on the right lobe surface immediately lateral to the median notch.
